user.title: Dimmer Thermostat
user.description: Proportional temperature control of a heat source on a dimmer. Pick the sensor that measures the space and the dimmer that drives the lamp; everything else can be tuned afterwards.

data_description.temperature_sensor: Must report often enough to control on. Configure the device to report every few minutes at most.
data_description.dimmer_entity: A dimmable light, or a number entity that sets a level from 0 to 100.
data_description.max_output: The controller will never command more than this. Measure the actual surface temperature at full output before raising it.
data_description.backup_temperature_sensor: A second sensor in the same space. The thermostat controls on whichever sensor reads higher, either one can trip the over-temperature cut, and if one fails the other carries on.

reconfigure.title: Change sensors or dimmer
reconfigure.description: Point this thermostat at different entities. Tuning is unaffected.

data_description.backup_temperature_sensor: A second sensor in the same space. The thermostat controls on whichever sensor reads higher, either one can trip the over-temperature cut, and if one fails the other carries on.

error.not_dimmable: That light does not report a brightness capability, so it cannot be driven proportionally.
error.unsupported_dimmer: Pick a light, number or input_number entity.
error.same_sensor: The backup must be a different sensor from the primary.
error.unit_mismatch: The backup sensor reports in a different unit from the primary sensor.

abort.already_configured: That dimmer is already driven by another thermostat.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That dimmer belongs to a different thermostat.

regulation.title: Regulation
regulation.description: Find the output that holds your target by hand first. Then set the gain with integral time very long, and shorten integral time until the residual offset closes without overshoot.

data_description.kp: Percent of output per degree of error.
data_description.ti_minutes: Longer is gentler. Shorten it only until the steady offset closes.
data_description.cycle_seconds: How often the loop runs regardless of sensor reports.
data_description.startup_output: Where the integral starts, before any history exists.
data_description.send_deadband: Changes smaller than this are not sent, to spare the radio.
data_description.resend_seconds: The current level is re-sent at least this often.

data_description.min_output: Also the level the thermostat falls back to when anything goes wrong.

safety.title: Safety
safety.description: These are soft guards only. They cannot help if the radio link drops while the dimmer is holding a level, so keep an independent hardware over-temperature cutoff in the circuit.

data_description.overtemp_margin: Above setpoint plus this, the dimmer is cut outright.
data_description.sensor_max_age: Longer than this without a report counts as a sensor failure. Must be longer than the sensor's own reporting interval.
data_description.saturation_alert_seconds: How long the dimmer may sit at maximum while still too cold before you are warned about the bulb.

reset_integral.name: Reset integral
reset_integral.description: Clear the accumulated integral term, optionally preloading it. Use this after changing the bulb, the fixture or the enclosure.

preload.name: Preload
preload.description: Output percentage to start the integral from. Defaults to the configured startup output.
